blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp on Wednesday said her former household staff members were told to sign affidavits containing “false allegations” against her to appease the threats they reportedly received. Her legal counsel, Atty. Paolo Panelo, gave the update a day after saying that Duterte had received a message from a former staff member on Nov. 16 seeking help after being brought to Manila. The staff member said they were being held by certain individuals who threatened their lives and forced them to sign a document.
